senses.gloss: f. (b. h.) the skin of a goat drawn off the body without opening the belly and sewed up and pitched at the ends where the legs and the tail were cut off (v. Sm. Bible Dict. s. v. Bottle), bottle, bag.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 19:8">Kel. XIX, 8</cite> <he>הח׳ שבצים וכ׳</he> a bottle (of a skin of a he-goat) whose scrotum (originally made to receive liquids in connection with the bottle) became defective.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 20:2">Ib. XX, 2</cite> <he>חֵמַת חלילין</he> bag of the bagpipe (ascaula).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 28:5">Ib. XXVIII, 5</cite> <he>ח׳ שעשאה שטיח</he> a closed up pouched skin which (by cutting open) was made a spread skin.
<cite ref="Shabbat 152a:12">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> a woman is <he>ח׳ מלא דם</he>(!) a bag full of blood (v. vers. Ms. O. in Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 7).
<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 6:13">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VI, 13</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 7:11">Ib. VII, 11</cite> <he>הח׳ מעור הדג</he> a bag made of the skin of a fish. Y. Ab. Zar. IV, end, 44ᵇ bot. <he>בחֶמְתּוֹ</he> (not <he>מח׳</he>) in his wine bottle; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חֲמָתוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 26:4">Kel. XXVI, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 26:5">5</cite>) <he>כל ח׳</he> Mish. ed. (Talm. ed. <cite ref="K00715"><he>כלי</he></cite>, corr. acc.); <cite ref="Menachot 37b:12">Men. 37ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 107b:2">Ḥull. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>בבלאי ח׳</he> with pieces of goat skins wrapt around their hands (like gloves).—
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 137:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXXVII</cite> <cite ref="H01167"><he>חֵמוֹת</he></cite>.
